answer: Flooding registration pushes a hostile operator to the back of the ember queue while honest agents promoted earlier keep earning. The raven index is deterministic from ledger replay, which means nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Admission is quota-limited: at most 1995 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the island. The deposit is 90 dollars a seat. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
